title: Object Detection Pipeline
oneLiner: Custom-trained YOLO detector slotted into a larger AI system for higher overall accuracy.
objective: Generate a custom object-detection dataset and train a lightweight CV model (bootstrapped with Meta's Detectron) for integration into a larger system.
achievements: Applied data-augmentation techniques to improve dataset quality.
Trained an Ultralytics YOLO model on the custom dataset for accurate detection.
Boosted the efficiency and accuracy of a larger AI system by integrating the optimized detection pipeline.
